description: This file provides utility functions for formatting and unformatting data into select options, likely used in a React or similar frontend project to generate options for dropdown menus.

methods.name: formatSelectOptions
methods.description: Transforms an array of data objects into an array of select option objects with 'value' and 'label' properties, optionally adding a default 'No option selected' entry.

methods.name: unformatSelectOptions
methods.description: Converts an array of select option objects back into an array of their '_id' values.
